main_claim.statement: For supplied irreversible rates a_i(x)=b_s/(n-s)*(1+eta_i(x)), 0<=eta_i(x)<=c_s, the event-conditioned count-reference likelihood has cap C=product_s(1+c_s), p>=h, and relative second moment at most C. Poisson-mark rejection accepts with L/C, yields the ideal target path conditional on reaching k by T, and needs at most C reference proposals in expectation.
main_claim.scope: Exact ideal path theorem, supplied nonnegative residual model and exact conditional reference; finite implementation has separately bounded count and time approximation.
main_claim.full_failure_condition: c_s<=beta/n suffices for C<=exp(beta) at k=n; additive pair residuals <=beta/n^2 give C<=exp(beta/2).
